method.tokens: SDK 1.0.0 estimateTokens on normalized text messages: sum ceil(UTF-16 text.length / 4), not model tokenizer
method.tiers: Largest complete-session prefix not exceeding target; closest complete-session suffix to retained target
method.baseline: Same SDK SessionManager.inMemory + ExtensionRunner, no extensions and no model/provider/UI runtime
method.timing: External performance.now; production timing disabled in every arm; 5ms heartbeat excess over scheduled interval
method.ready: Real Worker commit response, followed by production commit promise microtasks; no source changes
method.memory: After readiness and one context query, main-thread global.gc then RSS/main heap; separate quiescent Worker.getHeapStatistics, no worker GC and no summing
method.warm: 20 context/tool samples per fresh process; tools get one untimed warmup; nearest-rank p50/p95 then median across processes
method.rssDelta: Median arm RSS minus same-tier median baseline RSS; not a sum of heaps
method.contextAdded: Median arm context percentile minus matching baseline context percentile; SDK clone included in both
method.background: Startup on a precompacted SDK session: session_start + session_compact dispatch through commit; SDK appendCompaction excluded
method.liveBatch: Next ten original source user/assistant pairs after prefix; append and real cadence hooks through commit; still uncompressed
method.cold: Separate immediate context request after session_tree reset; includes overlapping worker rebuild, do not add to background time
method.query: Original question for context/recall; grep first ASCII word of >=5 letters in question; expand middle compacted entry, defaults
